brief:
A London mosque has rejected a reprimand from Britain's charity regulator for a sermon that condemned "Zionists" in relation to Gaza, Middle East Eye reported. The Lewisham Islamic Centre said that expressing solidarity with the oppressed should not result in charitable sanction, pushing back against the watchdog's determination.

The statement suggests the mosque intends to maintain its position despite the regulator's action, framing the dispute as one concerning the boundaries of permissible speech for charities operating in Britain.
dek: UK mosque defiant after charity watchdog reprimand for sermon condemning 'Zionists' over Gaza Submitted by Imran Mulla on Thu, 11/12/2026 - 10:31 'Solidarity with the oppressed must not become grounds for charitable sanction', the Lewisham Islamic Centre said…
title: UK mosque defies charity watchdog over Gaza sermon criticism
